title: The Rust Moths
text: Thousands of moths with wings the color of rust settle over the party, soft as ash. Where they land, iron turns orange and flakes away. A buckle crumbles. A blade begins to bloom with rot.

options.label: Run before they eat the gear down to nothing.

outcomes.text: Most of the gear makes it, though some of the armor does not.

options.label: The most armored draws them off, giving the moths a feast.

outcomes.text: They feast on that armor until it falls apart, while the rest of you go free.

options.label: The cleverest smokes them off with a fire to save what iron is left.

outcomes.text: The moths drift down like ash, sleepy, and their dust is worth something.
